feature.users.description: Account settings, sessions, display preferences, member list, profiles and account merges.
feature.users.name: People
users.admin.approve_confirm: Merge these accounts now? This cannot be undone.
users.admin.delete_source_hint: Otherwise it is renamed, made a plain user with an unknown password and suspended; only an administrator can reactivate it.
users.admin.execute_confirm: Merge these accounts now? This cannot be undone.

users.admin.nothing_to_move: The source account owns nothing that would move.
users.admin.target_hint: Receives the data and is kept.
users.display.background_hint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to {size} MB. Large pictures are scaled down.
users.display.colors_hint: Tick a colour to override the site theme with it.
users.display.dyslexic_font_hint: Uses OpenDyslexic when it is installed on your device.
users.display.more_options_hint: Colours, text emphasis and page widths.
users.display.pixels_hint: In pixels; leave empty for the default.
users.display.reset_confirm: Reset all display preferences to the defaults?
users.display.semantic_hint: Make formatting in page text stand out more.
users.display.title: Display preferences
users.error.background_too_large: The picture has too many pixels.
users.error.birth_date_invalid: Enter a valid birth date in the past.
users.error.last_admin: You are the last active administrator. Appoint another one first.
users.error.last_owner: The wiki needs at least one owner.
users.error.owner_blocked_by_temporary_r: Your role is temporary. An administrator must remove that schedule first.
users.error.owner_needs_owner: Only an owner or a superuser can make you an owner.
users.error.protected_account: This account is protected and cannot be deleted.
users.error.rename_limit: You can change your username at most {limit} times a day. Try again later.
users.flash.password_changed: Your password was changed and your other sessions were signed out.
users.flash.signed_out_everywhere: You were signed out of every device.
users.members.none: Nobody has published a profile yet.

users.merge.error.last_owner: The last owner cannot be merged away.
users.merge.error.no_such_user: There is no account with that username.
users.merge.error.not_confirmed: Both account owners must confirm the merge first.
users.merge.error.not_found: That merge request does not exist.

users.merge.flash.requested: Merge requested. The other account's owner must now confirm it.

users.merge.into_other: Move my account into the other one ({user} goes away)

users.merge.steps: Your password confirms your side of the request.

users.profile.calendar_help: Darker squares mean more edits. Choose a day to see what changed.
users.profile_edit.avatar_hint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 1 MB.
users.profile_edit.birth_date_hint: Only used to wish you a happy birthday on your profile.
users.profile_edit.disabled_notice: An administrator has disabled your profile page. Others cannot see it.
users.profile_edit.title: Edit profile
users.sessions.active_help: Devices where you are signed in. End any session you do not recognise.
users.sessions.clear_history_confirm: Delete the list of ended sessions?
users.sessions.impersonating: Sessions are not shown while you view the wiki as another user.
users.sessions.logout_all_confirm: Sign out of every device, including this one?
users.sessions.title: Sessions
users.settings.delete_warning: This permanently deletes your account, profile and preferences. Your edits stay in the page history without your name.
users.settings.owner_off: You are an administrator. Becoming an owner protects your account from changes by other administrators.
users.settings.owner_on: You are an owner of this wiki. Owners can only be changed by themselves.
